sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 4

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 4:1
items.html: The Mochin are ten Sefirot, discerned as GAR and ZAT, namely HB and ZON, each of which has ten Sefirot in it. And it is known that the ten Sefirot of the phase of the light of Hochma are discerned into five phases: KHB ZON. And the ten Sefirot of the light of Hassadim have no discernment of KHB in them, since the KHB descended in them to the discernment of HGT, and they are therefore called the five Hassadim: HGT NH, or HG: HGT NH. For the five phases of ZA are called HH, and the five phases of the Nukva are called HG. And these are the four Mochin, called: Hochma, Bina, Hassadim, and Gevurot. And these two lower Mochin, called HG, unite into one when they raise reflected light from below upward and couple with the two upper Mochin, called HB; and then HG, being but a single Mochin, is called the Mochin of the Daat. Thus the Daat is made from two distinct discernments, which are ZA and the Nukva of the Mochin, though they unite into a single Mochin by the secret of the coupling, as above. Therefore the Mochin of the Daat is discerned as made of two halves. See further in Answer 5. (Item 121).
